build_dataloader_train_eval: build train and eval data loaders with mixup augmentation and prefetcher support
build_dataloader_with_mixup: build a data loader that applies mixup and cutmix augmentation strategies
build_dataloader_distributed: build distributed data loaders for multi-GPU training with labeled memcached datasets

build_dataloader_validation: build a validation data loader with configurable crop percentage and batch size multiplier
